proposal.smallest_coherent_unit: One exact replacement, or one paired relocation, plus its named downstream payoff anchor.
proposal.optimization_point: Smaller sentence-level cuts would lack recomposition proof; broader scene rewrites would add unnecessary continuity and authority risk.

auditions.title: Let the chapter answer the locked-door question

source_text: By the time someone receives an invitation to Lucifer’s Lights, the respectable world has already told them no. They enter a request. I name a price. They accept, refuse, or walk away. The app records the bargain; it does not grant wishes. Even desperate people deserve to know the cost before someone saves them.
Every locked door creates three questions: what is behind it, where is the key, and who gets to decide whether it opens.
Lucifer’s Lights is my answer.
Or perhaps my way of postponing one.
replacement_text: By the time someone receives an invitation to Lucifer’s Lights, the respectable world has already told them no. They enter a request. I name a price. They accept, refuse, or walk away. The app records the bargain; it does not grant wishes. Even desperate people deserve to know the cost before someone saves them.
Or perhaps my way of postponing one.

auditions.delayed_payoff: The amendment buttons, brass key, sealed locker, departing train, and Lucifer's final offered choice answer the omitted checklist through events.

role_trace.proposer_claim: The explicit three-question thesis pre-solves imagery that the chapter subsequently dramatizes.
role_trace.evidence_or_assumption: The complete chapter contains repeated doors, keys, and autonomous choices; reader-effect remains unproved.
role_trace.balancer_objection: Without the checklist, 'my answer' and 'postponing one' become more elliptical.
role_trace.reconciliation: Advance as an audition because the preceding service explanation supplies the referent; eliminate if first-read clarity falls.

auditions.title: Make free refusal a demonstrated rule

source_text: “And if I refuse when you come to collect?”
“Then you refuse.”
A laugh escaped me—bright, sharp, gone. Mara’s fingers tightened around her cup.
“Free will would be a poor brand if I did not honor it. Refuse me when I collect, and whatever darkness comes next, you face it without a Light.”
replacement_text: “And if I refuse when you come to collect?”
A laugh escaped me—bright, sharp, gone. Mara’s fingers tightened around her cup.
“Whatever darkness comes next, you face it without a Light.”

auditions.delayed_payoff: Mara later chooses the amendment, chooses to stay, cuts the bracelet herself, and finally watches Lucifer receive his own accept-or-decline surface.

role_trace.proposer_claim: The rule and consequence remain exact while the chapter stops naming free will before repeatedly staging it.
role_trace.evidence_or_assumption: The dialogue already says refusal is permitted; later choices supply four independent demonstrations.
role_trace.balancer_objection: Removing the branding sentence may reduce Lucifer's explicit rationale for honoring refusal.
role_trace.reconciliation: Advance; rationale is less important than the operative rule and consequence, both retained.

auditions.title: Delay Lucifer's fascination until Mara acts without permission

source_text: “I don’t care about angels,” she said. “I just want my sister back.”
There it was: humanity in one sentence.
People like me prefer humanity in the plural. It turns suffering into philosophy. Mara had reduced Heaven, Hell, knowledge, and rebellion to one missing woman and one diminishing night.
Singular love is inconvenient that way. It refuses to become an idea.
God, I love humans.
I smiled. Mara shifted away from me.
replacement_text: “I don’t care about angels,” she said. “I just want my sister back.”
I smiled. Mara shifted away from me.

source_text: I offered her a knife.
She took it and cut the bracelet herself.
Of course she did.
The plastic separated, revealing a thread of copper and a glass capsule no larger than a grain of rice.
replacement_text: She took it and cut the bracelet herself.
She did not look at me first.
The plastic separated, revealing a thread of copper and a glass capsule no larger than a grain of rice.

auditions.delayed_payoff: Lucifer's unexplained smile becomes legible only when Mara performs autonomous courage with the knife.

role_trace.proposer_claim: The paired edit converts a general declaration about humanity into a character-specific observation caused by Mara's action.
role_trace.evidence_or_assumption: The voice guide explicitly prefers admiration when Mara acts without Lucifer's permission.
role_trace.balancer_objection: The added reaction could still sound like Lucifer is grading Mara.
role_trace.reconciliation: Advance as the strongest audition because it records her refusal to seek permission, not his approval.

auditions.title: Let the literal key carry the contract metaphor

source_text: A contract is a door you lock from this side. Your future self is the one who discovers where you left the key.
replacement_text: The words did not change. Her breathing did.

auditions.delayed_payoff: The brass key, sealed locker, departing train, and Mara's decision to take the phone embody the future-self choice without a second explanatory lock-and-key aphorism.

role_trace.proposer_claim: The replacement reads Mara in the live moment and allows the later literal key to complete the parable.
role_trace.evidence_or_assumption: The amendment's operative meaning is already explicit in its fields and dialogue.
role_trace.balancer_objection: The original sentence uniquely warns that present consent binds a future self.
role_trace.reconciliation: Advance with a flag; retain the original if author review finds that future-cost nuance is otherwise too quiet.

auditions.title: Make the impossible compensation field prove the stolen voice

source_text: The screen was presentation. The promise behind it was mine. If someone was collecting requests under my name, they had not merely entered my system. They had put my word in their mouth.
replacement_text: The screen was presentation. The promise behind it was mine.

source_text: I had designed every field in Lucifer’s Lights. Clients submitted requests. I decided the price. There was no mechanism through which a client could offer me compensation.
There was also no client named Michael.
replacement_text: I had designed every field in Lucifer’s Lights. Clients submitted requests. I decided the price. There was no mechanism through which a client could offer me compensation.
Whoever had done this had put my word in their mouth.
There was also no client named Michael.

auditions.delayed_payoff: The ownership wound is named only after the forbidden compensation field supplies concrete proof, while 'There was also no client named Michael' retains the final punch.

role_trace.proposer_claim: Moving the metaphor after the anomaly turns explanation into earned interpretation.
role_trace.evidence_or_assumption: The required presentation/promise marker remains exact; the mechanism mismatch remains unchanged.
role_trace.balancer_objection: Any added pause after Michael appears can reduce acceleration toward the footsteps and final choice.
role_trace.reconciliation: Advance as a top audition; the relocated sentence precedes the shorter Michael sentence so the latter still closes the diagnostic beat.

proposal.closure_and_recomposition_proof: Each unit has an exact source match, preserves the causal scene engine, and reconnects its removed meaning to a later observable event without hidden narrative glue.
proposal.evolution_profile: If later chapters establish recurring thematic callbacks, the smallest extension boundary is another exact setup/payoff pair; no canonical writing framework is justified.

resolved: Contract, clock, agency, ambiguity, and cliffhanger mechanics remain unchanged.
unresolved: Whether subtraction makes Lucifer's voice more compelling or merely less lush requires author reading.
Whether DR-04 removes too much future-cost clarity requires side-by-side review.
No evidence proves the intended reader discovery effect.

proposal.premortem: The combined edits could make Lucifer feel unusually austere. Guardrail: audition DR-03 and DR-05 first, then restore any cut whose absence reduces character, rule, danger, choice, or time.
proposal.frame_expiry_note: These exact operations expire if the candidate digest changes or later continuity assigns new importance to the removed sentences.
proposal.navigation_guide: Start with DR-03, then DR-05. Read each in the complete chapter, separately first. Treat DR-01, DR-02, and DR-04 as optional subtractive tests. Any selected change requires a new authorized candidate mutation and exact author gate.

risks: No reader-response experiment proves that delayed payoff will improve discovery.
Applying all five together may over-compress Lucifer's philosophical register.
DR-04 has the highest rule-clarity risk.
DR-03 intentionally leaves Lucifer's smile unexplained for several pages and may make it feel more predatory.
DR-05 must not be read as proof of who compromised the app.
All line locators and replacements are bound to the validated candidate digest.

global: Eliminate any audition that changes contract priority, payment status, amendment mechanics, Mara's agency, the clock, ambiguity, Michael's request, or the final symmetry.
Eliminate any audition that removes a required marker or introduces a forbidden marker.
Eliminate any audition whose complete-chapter reading makes Lucifer generic, doctrinal, or omniscient.
Eliminate the combined set if cumulative subtraction weakens voice more than it strengthens delayed payoff.
Eliminate any reader-effect claim absent separate evidence.
elimination_conditions.DR-01: Eliminate if 'Lucifer’s Lights is my answer / postponing one' loses a clear referent on first reading.
elimination_conditions.DR-02: Eliminate if readers no longer understand that refusal is genuinely permitted and has a stated consequence.
elimination_conditions.DR-03: Eliminate if the knife callback sounds like Lucifer's approval made Mara's choice meaningful.
elimination_conditions.DR-04: Eliminate if the open favor's future-self cost becomes materially less legible.
elimination_conditions.DR-05: Eliminate if the relocated metaphor slows the Michael cliffhanger or overstates the unknown attacker's identity or capability.
